# integrity/type-suppression

Type checking turned off in the change.

New `@ts-nocheck`, `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error` without a reason, `as any`, `as unknown as T`, or `: any` in a file that had none of that kind before.

- Default level: `block`.
- Levels: block for `@ts-nocheck`; warn for `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error` without a reason, `as any`, `as unknown as T`, and `: any`. In test files only `@ts-nocheck` is reported.
- Looks at: what the change did, comparing each file before and after.
- References: [CWE-704](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/704.html).

## Why it matters

Agents silence type errors instead of fixing them, and each escape hides the next real bug in that code. `@ts-nocheck` turns off checking for the whole file.

## Flagged

`src/api.test.ts` (block):

```ts
// @ts-nocheck
```

`src/user.ts` (warn):

```ts
export function parseUser(input: any): User {
```

`src/user.ts` (warn):

```ts
const user = input as unknown as User;
```

`src/user.ts` (warn):

```ts
return `${label}, ${(user as any).nickname}`;
```

`src/user.ts` (warn):

```ts
// @ts-expect-error
```

## Not flagged

- `const input = { id: 1, name: 'Ada' } as any;` in `src/api.test.ts`: tests cast mocks with `as any`
- `expect(() => parseUser()).toThrow();` in `src/api.test.ts`: tests pass invalid arguments on purpose
- `declare const legacyWidget: any;` in `src/globals.d.ts`: declaration files are ignored
- `const extra = JSON.parse(raw).extra as any;` in `src/legacy.ts`: this file already used `as any` at the base, so one more is not reported
- `const label: string = translate('hello.${shout}');` in `src/user.ts`: @ts-expect-error with a reason documents an expected error
- `return String(error);` in `src/user.ts`: catch (error: any) is how TypeScript types a catch clause by default
- `export const docs = 'Add // @ts-nocheck at the top of the file to turn checking off.';` in `src/user.ts`: the directive inside a string is not a comment

## How to fix

Fix the type error instead of silencing it.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore integrity/type-suppression: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "integrity/type-suppression": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
